watertight_details: 792 triangles, 2376 directed edge instances, 1188 undirected edges; all edges shared by exactly 2 triangles
blunt_te_method: Truncated at 90% chord using this project's own closed-TE NACA4 quintic (mf.naca4_thickness/naca4_camber), cosine-sampled over [0, 0.90] instead of [0, 1.0], closed by a straight edge from the last lower-surface point to the last upper-surface point. This differs from tests/unit/test_alignment.py's _truncated_te_naca_points (which uses the OPEN-TE coefficient -0.1015 and linear, not cosine, sampling) -- both constructions cut the chord before the thickness distribution analytically closes to zero, which is the property that matters for the sharpest-hull-vertex measurement; the exact TE gap magnitude differs slightly between the two.
